1.why: All eight screens show a static, uncluttered layout with no moving images, animations, or pop-ups.

2.why: Highlighted progress tabs, blue Next-step banners, and solid primary buttons make key elements stand out on every screen.

3.why: Clear headings, persistent next-step instructions, and a single obvious primary action per page let the user locate what to do quickly.

4.why: Visible progress bar and Next-step reminders reduce memory load, though password-complexity rules and log-panel secrets still require some recall.

5.why: No password-manager hint, autofill affordance, or Remember-me option appears on any of the screens.

6.why: Input fields are blank and no previously saved emails, devices, or familiar items are displayed for recognition.

7.why: Copy throughout is short, plain-language sentences that are easy to read.

8.why: No error states or error messages are shown in any screenshot, so the claim cannot be upheld.

9.why: Password rules are listed and next-step tips are given, yet no concrete example values (sample password or code format) are provided.

10.why: The flow offers only password-plus-OTP; it never presents clear choices among password, code, or face-login methods.

11.why: Each screen presents one primary action and at most two secondary buttons, avoiding choice overload.

12.why: Green confirmation banners explicitly state the outcome after every major step (code checked, password changed, privacy accepted, etc.).

13.why: Every page includes a Next-step tip banner plus a persistent Get-help-and-safety-advice link.

14.why: Start-recovery-again / Restart buttons are present on multiple steps, letting the user retry easily.

15.why: Header, progress tabs, card layout, button styles, and help footer remain visually and structurally identical across all eight steps.
